content: initValue on the level of a ComSpec is relevant for connec- tions to the corresponding PortPrototype Please note that (along the example of sender-receiver communication) only the initValue defined in the context of a 201 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 ParameterProvideComSpec or ParameterRequireComSpec is relevant for con- nections to the corresponding PortPrototype . An initValue defined in the scope of a ParameterDataPrototype is ignored.
